description: This is a React functional component for the CustomerPage, allowing users to create repair bookings and track their status with real-time updates via Supabase Realtime. It manages state for repairs, form inputs, and loading/error messages, and handles subscriptions to real-time repair data.

methods.name: mergeRepair(list, updated)
methods.description: Updates the local repairs list with an updated repair, either inserting new or replacing existing entry.

methods.name: CustomerPage()
methods.description: Main functional React component for the customer dashboard, managing repair bookings and real-time updates.

methods.name: refreshDetail
methods.description: Fetches the latest details for a specific repair and updates the repairs list.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new repair booking based on user input.
